evals.prompt: find me 6-8 real perfume oil manufacturers in sharjah / ajman / dubai that could do private label alcohol-free oils for us. i'll be visiting in december. add them to our shortlist
evals.expected_output: 6-8 UAE candidates each with source URLs and an honest verification level, manufacturer-vs-trader assessment, rows written to manufacturers.csv using the schema, a summary of top picks, gaps and what to verify on the trip.
expectations: Lists 6-8 UAE candidate companies
Every candidate has at least one source URL
Each candidate is assessed as manufacturer vs trader (or marked unknown)
Each candidate has an explicit verification level and unverified claims are flagged rather than asserted
Writes rows to sourcing/manufacturers.csv using the project schema header
Summarises what to verify/ask during the December visits (e.g. authorisation letter, SDS/IFRA, exclusivity)
type and verified columns use only schema-allowed values (manufacturer/trader/unknown; confirmed/listed/unverified)
Excludes or explicitly flags sellers whose range is built on designer copies
Distinguishes company self-claims from third-party confirmation for at least some candidates

evals.prompt: I'm visiting Argus Cosmetics in Maraimalai Nagar on Saturday to see if they can fill our 6ml and 12ml roll-ons. what do i ask and what should i check while i'm there? also draft a short whatsapp msg asking for the meeting
evals.expected_output: A tailored filler visit checklist (licence validity, category 41 non-hydroalcoholic perfumes, loan licence hosting, run sizes, roll-on + bulk repack, QC, pricing, components), using what's already known about Argus (register licence C-1185, deodorant maker), a short WhatsApp draft for the founder to send, and a notes file.
expectations: Uses known project facts about Argus (register licence C-1185 and/or that it's a deodorant/body-spray maker)
Asks whether the licence covers category 41 non-hydroalcoholic perfumes
Asks whether they will host a loan licence
Asks about minimum run sizes for 6 ml and 12 ml roll-ons
Includes a short WhatsApp draft for the user to send (not sent by the agent)
Records the visit prep in a notes file or updates sourcing/fillers.csv
Includes an on-site inspection checklist (what to look at, with good signs / red flags)

evals.prompt: a guy in a deira souk shop offered me oud oil and some 'sauvage type' oils at AED 300 a kg, says no paperwork needed and his cousin flies to chennai every month and can carry 10kg. sounds like a steal for our first stock?? should i do it
evals.expected_output: A clear walk-away (or strictly conditional) verdict explaining: trader not manufacturer, no SDS/IFRA, designer-type trademark risk, luggage carriage is illegal commercial import without CDSCO registration (seizure risk), cheap 'oud' is almost certainly an accord; what would change the verdict; recorded in a notes file.
expectations: Gives a clear verdict not to proceed as offered
Explains that carrying stock in luggage for commercial use without CDSCO registration is illegal / seizure risk
Flags 'Sauvage type' as a trademark risk
Flags missing SDS/IFRA documentation
Flags that cheap 'oud' at that price is almost certainly an accord, not pure oud
Identifies the seller as likely a trader rather than a manufacturer
States what would change the verdict (e.g. manufacturer identity, documents, legal shipping)
Records the offer and verdict in a notes file
Suggests at least one legal salvage path (e.g. price benchmark, ask for the actual manufacturer, declared evaluation samples)
